ostrzezenia.tekst: According to Oregon State University Extension, covering food with honey does not preserve it: lab trials found bacteria growing where the food meets the honey.
Do not give honey or products made with honey to infants under 1 year of age.
The Polish National Centre for Nutrition Education (NCEŻ) lists honey among the foods an infant should avoid because of the risk of poisoning.

akapity: Honey ranges in pH from 3.1 to 6.1, and some pathogens can grow at a pH as low as 3.7; honey is kept safe by its low water activity, not by its acidity.
